# Human Super Intelligence (HSI)

> Connecting human biology. Advancing scientific discovery. Transforming our understanding of health.

Human Super Intelligence is one product. Four governed modules share the Living Health Knowledge Graph: Aksh Health (patient intelligence), HSI Clinical (longitudinal authorised clinical intelligence), ISI / Immune Super Intelligence (scientific discovery) and HSI Trials (studies, biomarkers and governed pre-screening). ISI science does not depend on Aksh Health. Private patient data does not enter the research graph automatically.

For research and education. Not a clinical decision system, not a regulatory approval, and not a commercial care service.

Canonical site: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/
Sitemap: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/sitemap.xml
Robots: https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/robots.txt

## Governed modules

- [Aksh Health](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/modules/aksh-health): Patient intelligence inside HSI
- [HSI Clinical](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/modules/clinical): Longitudinal clinical intelligence
- [ISI](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/modules/isi): Immune and cross-system scientific discovery
- [HSI Trials](https://www.humansuperintelligence.tech/modules/trials): Governed pre-screening. Live matching and enrolment are not currently offered

## Honesty / non-goals

- No live clinical decision support and no patient PHI in the research graph
- Gate C / scientific promotion remains human-gated
- Account signup does not grant research write or reviewer permissions
- APIs under `/api/` and internal `/_pages/` HTML are not public discovery surfaces
- This site does not claim real patients, clinical validation, regulatory approval or commercial availability
